items.exampleEn: The receptionist gave us our room keys.
items.exampleZh: 櫃台人員把房間鑰匙給了我們。

items.exampleEn: My uncle started his own company last year.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年自己開了一家公司。

items.exampleEn: The hotel staff were very kind.
New workers get two weeks of training.
items.exampleZh: 新員工會接受兩週的訓練。

items.exampleEn: I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
She took professional photos at our wedding.
items.exampleZh: 她在我們的婚禮上拍了專業的照片。
農場的勞動工作很辛苦。

items.exampleEn: He earned his first money at sixteen.
items.exampleZh: 他十六歲時賺到了人生第一筆錢。

items.sentenceEn: Our company has about fifty staff.
items.sentenceZh: 我們公司大約有五十名員工。

items.audioEn: The training starts at nine, so please don't be late.
items.audioZh: 訓練九點開始，請不要遲到。

items.sentenceEn: The manager wants to see you now.
He earns more than his father now.
items.sentenceZh: 他現在賺得比他爸爸還多。

items.stemEn: Hi, where is the ____? I need to check in.
items.stemZh: 你好，櫃台人員在哪裡？我要辦入住。

items.stemEn: She works hard and ____ a lot of money.
items.stemZh: 她工作很努力，賺了很多錢。

items.passageEn: Jenny works as a receptionist at a big company. Every morning, she welcomes visitors and answers the phone. Last month, the company gave all the staff a week of training. Jenny learned to speak to customers in a professional way. Her manager was very happy with her work, and now she earns a little more money.
items.passageZh: Jenny 在一家大公司當櫃台接待員。每天早上，她接待訪客、接聽電話。上個月，公司給全體員工安排了一週的訓練。Jenny 學會用專業的方式和客人說話。她的經理對她的表現很滿意，現在她的薪水也多了一點。

questions.questionZh: 上個月公司給員工安排了什麼？

items.promptZh: 這個城市的勞力成本很高。
referenceEn: The cost of labor is high in this city.
Labor is expensive in this city.
rubricZh: 「勞力」用 labor（不可數，不加 s）
「成本很高」可寫例如 the cost of labor is high、labor is expensive

items.instructionZh: 用 earn 造一個句子，說說你或家人怎麼賺錢。
referenceEn: I earn extra money by teaching piano on weekends.
My brother earns a lot as an engineer.
rubricZh: earn 表示「賺（錢）」，可寫例如 earn money by＋動詞 -ing、earn a lot as＋職業
主詞第三人稱單數時動詞加 s（例如 earns）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：This job needs a lot of labor. 英文不自然，且 need labor 易被理解為「需要很多人手（工人）」而非「很耗體力」；中文「需要很多勞力」宜對應 This job takes a lot of hard work／This job is hard physical labor. 第二句 takes a lot of labor 也偏生硬。建議改題目或改參考答案
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "這個城市的勞力成本很高。"（原 "做這份工作需要很多勞力。"）；need labor 不自然且易誤解，改題目為 labor 的常用搭配 the cost of labor
